projects.title: TileBase L1 v1
projects.subtitle: Low-profile modular battle tile base
projects.description: First layer BattleTiles base focused on repeatable tabletop terrain alignment, resin-printable geometry, and a clean foundation for future magnetic or powered tile concepts.
notes: Baseline tile geometry for the BattleTiles system.
Useful for showing scale, modularity, and layer progression.
Pairs with L2/L3 versions to show iteration.

projects.title: TileBase L2 v1
projects.subtitle: Second layer BattleTiles base iteration
projects.description: A follow-up layer prototype for the BattleTiles system, intended to demonstrate iterative CAD development and stacked terrain/platform design logic.
notes: Shows how the base system evolves by layer.
Keeps the project family grouped instead of scattered.
Good candidate for future magnetic indexing details.

projects.title: TileBase L3 v1
projects.subtitle: Third layer BattleTiles base iteration
projects.description: A higher layer concept in the BattleTiles family, showing how the system can support varied terrain heights while preserving a shared design language.
notes: Demonstrates layered terrain progression.
Highlights modular product thinking.
Can support a future revision with more detailed alignment hardware.

projects.title: PowerTile V1
projects.subtitle: Sliced powered tile manufacturing file
projects.description: Manufacturing-side CTB file for the powered tile concept. This is included as process evidence for resin printer preparation, orientation, supports, and production workflow.
notes: Use the CTB as manufacturing evidence rather than viewer geometry.
Pairs with the BattleTiles family as the electronics/power direction.
Good place to add LED, magnet, or conductive contact notes later.

projects.title: Mid Speaker Mount — Top
projects.subtitle: Automotive component speaker mount top shell
projects.description: Top half of a custom mid speaker mounting solution for vehicle audio fitment. Presented as a real-world functional CAD part rather than decorative modeling.
notes: Part of a two-piece mount system.
Shows practical fitment, mounting geometry, and real installation intent.
Download set includes STL, FreeCAD source, and CTB manufacturing files.

projects.title: Mid Speaker Mount — Bottom
projects.subtitle: Automotive component speaker mount lower shell
projects.description: Bottom half of the mid speaker mounting system, designed to support clean fitment and a serviceable two-piece print strategy.
notes: Complements the top shell model.
Two-piece design makes the print and install path easier to explain.
Useful project for demonstrating CAD-to-install workflow.

projects.title: Universal Tweeter Mount
projects.subtitle: Universal tweeter fitment adapter
projects.description: Compact universal tweeter mount for adapting small audio components into a cleaner custom installation package.
notes: Small functional part with clear fitment purpose.
Good example of practical CAD use for automotive customization.
Includes STL, source CAD, and CTB file paths.

projects.title: 1/4in Socket Tree Test
projects.subtitle: Workshop socket organization prototype
projects.description: Prototype socket tree for 1/4in sockets. The next revision will use a larger base with two holes for surface-mounted inductive sensors, turning the storage concept into an inventory-aware tool system.
notes: Current version validates socket spacing and physical storage layout.
Next version: larger base with two surface inductive sensor holes.
Portfolio value: bridges CAD, electronics, and inventory software thinking.

projects.title: 3/8in Socket Tree Test
projects.subtitle: Workshop socket organization prototype
projects.description: Prototype socket tree for 3/8in sockets. This is part of a larger smart tool storage concept where physical tool presence can be detected and logged by software.
notes: Current model supports the mechanical layout phase.
Future larger base will include two sensor mounting holes.
Strong recruiter story: mechanical design + sensor concept + software inventory system.
